comment: role.c genl_player_setup() with no name, role, race, gender or alignment in the rc: the gender and alignment menus' extra entries. Role menu '"' opens gender; '[' opens alignment; '?' returns to role; '"' then '/' opens race; '"' returns to gender; '~' cancelled with Escape makes reset_role_filtering() return FALSE and stays on gender. Male, Priest and elf (alignment forced chaotic) reach the confirmation, where 'n' starts over. Role menu '[' then '~' committed with nothing picked also returns FALSE and stays on alignment; neutral, Healer, gnome and female reach the confirmation again.
